_comment: Spell ids with NO icon on db.ascension.gg. A CoA ability with no art is very likely not actually in the game -- unimplemented, cut, or a leftover database row. Treat every id here as suspect until someone logs in and looks.
_method: tools/fetch_spell_icons.py harvests the `g_spells` map from each db.ascension.gg spell page; that map carries art for every spell a page references, so an id still unresolved after its own page was fetched has none. Checked only the abilities that appear in notes/raid-utility.md.
_refresh: Re-run the check in tools/utility_tables.py --icons, then re-run the generator. Confirmed-in-game ids should be DELETED from `ids` with a note in `confirmed_present`.
